svg.text: STAGE 448 · TOPIC 88 · SVG 92 · 🎉 HISTORIC P890, 90TH FAQ & 890-TEST TRIPLE MILESTONE (P889–P890 🎉)
Enterprise WebRTC RFC 6544 ICE-TCP & RFC 4571 Framing / HoL Burst Flush Guard
Eliminating 16-Bit Length-Prefix Desync, Nagle Coalescing Stalls & TCP Head-of-Line (HoL) Chipmunk Fast-Forward Bursts
🎉 P890 · 90TH FAQ · 890 TESTS
451 Dims · 899 Guards · 908 Probes
❌ Unguarded ICE-TCP Failure: 16-Bit Desync & HoL Chipmunk Burst
1. RFC 4571 16-Bit Length Desync & Nagle Coalescing Stall
• Missing TCP_NODELAY: Nagle + Delayed ACK coalesces 20ms frames (+140ms).
• Partial socket write or unvalidated 2B LENGTH (>1400B) reads encrypted
Opus payload bytes as next 16-bit LENGTH (e.g., 0xB800 = 47,104 bytes).
• Parser stalls for 12+ seconds waiting for 47KB → permanent dead air!
Result: Permanent Byte-Stream Framing Desync & Nagle Latency Spikes
2. TCP Head-of-Line (HoL) Avalanche & Passive-Passive Deadlock
• 1% Wi-Fi TCP loss holds 10 newer Opus frames hostage in OS kernel buffer.
• When retransmission arrives at T=180ms, kernel dumps all 200ms in 0.1ms.
• Jitter buffer plays queued avalanche at 2.5x speed ("Chipmunk Voice")!
• Plus passive-passive deadlock or enterprise NAT Simultaneous-Open drop.
Result: Jarring 2.5x Chipmunk Fast-Forward Bursts & Handshake Deadlock
✅ RFC 4571 Framing Lock (P889) & HoL Burst Flush Guard (P890 🎉)
P889 · RFC 4571 [12, 1400]B Framing & Mandatory TCP_NODELAY Guard
• Enforces setsockopt(TCP_NODELAY=1) on all ICE-TCP & TURN-TCP sockets.
• Validates 2B RFC 4571 LENGTH ∈ [12, 1400] bytes + RFC 7983 first byte.
• Atomic frame writes + immediate stream resync on boundary violation.
• Zero Nagle-coalesced stalls & zero 16-bit framing desync freezes!
clampedFramingDesyncedOrNagleCoalescedFrames = 0 · Frame ∈ [12, 1400]B
P890 🎉 · RFC 6544 Active-Passive Role & [60, 240]ms HoL Flush Guard
• Strict Pairing: Client tcptype active → SFU tcptype passive (no so glare).
• Post-Stall HoL Burst Cap: clamps queued burst span to [60, 240]ms (120ms).
• Trims stale silence/leading frames on TCP retransmit burst arrival so
audio resumes immediately at 1.0x natural pitch (0 chipmunk bursts)!
clampedHolChipmunkBurstOrDeadlockedCandidatePairs = 0 · HoL ∈ [60, 240]ms
